findings.message: The submit-path comment still reads 'S002 ac2:' — a label from the PRIOR vs-code-chat-ui-overhaul epic's S002 (Send-Stop), not this ux-polish Story. Cosmetic only; the code is correct. Consider normalizing the residual 'S002 ac2/ac3' labels to 'S002 (ux-polish)' for the retired-button region to avoid cross-epic label drift.

The textarea placeholder '(⌘↵ to send)' still advertises only the keyboard send path; now that the leading '>' is also a click/Enter/Space send control the hint is slightly incomplete. Intentionally left unchanged per t1's acceptance ('#insrc-input's placeholder unchanged'), so not a defect — recording as a discoverability observation for a future copy tweak.
